from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """A legal judgment document with its title and cause of action."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title as named")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The official cause of action (案由) of this document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document: ruling, judgment, etc.")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="Whether criminal, civil, or administrative case")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short excerpt showing the cause of action classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[LegalDocument]
